text: Michael Hain, Senior Planner, Policy and Modelling Unit, City Planning Division will provide an update on the transportation component of the City of Toronto's Official Plan Review. The Review is in its second of two phases and is currently focussed on the review of policies related to: transit, cycling, automated vehicles and shared mobility, and street related map and schedules. Staff are seeking feedback regarding how accessibility has been incorporated into the Official Plan's transportation policies.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
